original_summary.legacy_key_meaning: Released case IDs, equal-case means and case support counts; these keys do not establish distinct subjects.

preserved_readouts.correct_interpretation: All eight released validation cases are retained; subject independence is unverified.
Training cases only; distinct subject identity was not verified.

independence_status.consequence: Source test-retest design is a provenance risk, not proof of an AVT repeat pair or leakage; absence of leakage is also unverified.

paired_analysis_interpretation: Paired case summaries are descriptive. Case bootstrap uncertainty is exploratory and conditional on unverified case independence; same-subject dependence could affect uncertainty and held-out generalization.
